promptState.text:
How the reference pictures align with the target video — Picture 1 (from Shot 1) aligns with the 0.00-second mark of the target video; Picture 2 (from Shot 1) aligns with the 5.00-second mark of the target video.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, fashion studio cinematic style, the woman shown in Picture 1 begins facing forward against the neutral studio backdrop. She initiates a smooth 360-degree pirouette, pivoting gracefully on her feet as her red satin dress swirls around her body. As her back turns to the camera, the red satin dress seamlessly transforms into a crisp white short-sleeved t-shirt and high-waisted pink jeans. Completing the full turn back to facing forward, her blonde wavy hair flows naturally through the rotation, and she raises her left hand with small amplitude at slow speed to gently touch and adjust a strand of hair beside her face before resting her arms downward and settling into the exact frontal pose, eye level, neutral lighting, and composition established by Picture 2.

overall_soundscape: Quiet indoor studio ambience continues throughout with subtle fabric rustle from the turn and soft movement of hair.

non_diegetic_music: Chic, mid-tempo electronic fashion synth bed with light atmospheric pads and gentle percussion that cleanly resolves at the end.

nodes.title: Sampler settings (tested)
widgets_values:
{"version": 1, "content": "

SAMPLER SETTINGS FOR THE SPEED LORA

First and last frame mode has two anchors: the video must start on Picture 1 and end on Picture 2. Both were measured. The number is how far a frame is from the picture it should match, so lower is better. Under about 5 you cannot tell them apart; over about 20 it is a different picture.

PICK ONE FROM THE DROPDOWN

CombinationStartEndTimeNotes
euler + simple3.124.2140sThe default here.
euler + sgm_uniform3.114.2342sTied with simple. Nothing separates them.
res_multistep + simple3.124.4342sFine.
euler + beta3.254.4442sFine. This one leads in the first frame only workflow.
dpmpp_sde_gpu + sgm_uniform3.945.4964sSlightly behind and 50 percent slower for the same steps.

Only one seed was tested here, which is enough to show that no pairing is broken and that the sampler barely matters. It is not enough to say the top two differ: treat the first four as equally good and pick on render time.


BOTH ENDS HOLD

The end frame lands on Picture 2 about as well as the start lands on Picture 1 (4.2 against 3.1). The middle of the clip sits around 60, which is what you want: it means the video really travels between the two pictures instead of sitting still.


ddim_uniform IS STILL THE ONE TO AVOID

It scored 8.97 and 7.98, the worst of the six. It is less catastrophic here than in the first frame only workflow, where it scored 70 and replaced the starting picture with a wall of unrelated photographs. Two anchors seem to hold it together. It is still last, and there is no reason to choose it.


STEPS: USE 8, NOT 4

The LoRA is called a 4 step LoRA and 4 steps is enough for the picture. It is not enough for the sound. Found by blind listening: four clips, same seed, only the step count different, names shuffled and volume matched. Ranked best to worst twice, on different seeds: 12 > 8 > 6 > 4 both times.

8 is the sweet spot. Same picture quality as 4, better sound, about 10 seconds more. 12 sounds best but the picture starts drifting from your input and it takes nearly twice as long. Measuring tools could not find this at all: harshness, noisiness and echo were measured across 54 clips and found nothing. Only listening found it.


THE OTHER SETTINGS THAT MATTER

Shift 6 on the node feeding the sampler. This LoRA was trained for shift 6, while the model on its own defaults to 12. Leave it at 6, and leave shift_audio at 3.

The alignment line must carry your duration. The first line of the prompt says Picture 2 aligns with the 5.00 second mark. If you change the Duration, change that number too or the ending will not land where you asked.

Audio fade 120 on Save Mp4. AI clips start their sound at full level in a single step, heard as a click. 120 removes it.

Control after generate under the seed: set it to fixed once you find a clip you like, or the seed changes on the next run and you cannot get it back.
